properties.description: Consolidate the already implemented but not yet accepted MVP work into one serial stage. Preserve every original task, attached evidence, required reviewer and mandatory check. Execute in order: verify earlier implementation → its existing planning/chat/annotation review → verify sign-in/editor fixes → their existing review. Each verification group contains one dependency chain. A review request is not approval; no task becomes complete merely through this replan. This stage follows approval of the updated MVP delivery plan and must finish before new execution-model work begins.
properties.title: Complete acceptance of the earlier MVP work
